Gold.note: Central bank accumulation and macro hedging sustain strong price momentum.

Silver.note: High beta to gold combined with robust industrial demand from solar manufacturing.

Copper.note: Structural deficit driven by electrification and EV demand amid constrained mine supply.

Uranium.note: Structural supply deficit and renewed global nuclear build-out support long-term contracting.

Lithium.note: Near-term oversupply from new capacity offsets long-term EV demand growth.

Nickel.note: Surplus Indonesian supply growth continues to outpace sluggish stainless steel demand.

Zinc.note: Tight concentrate markets and recent mine closures support prices despite modest demand.

Iron Ore.note: Weak Chinese property sector and steel demand cap upside despite steady supply.

Coal.note: Steady baseload power demand balances against long-term energy transition headwinds.

Rare Earths.note: Near-term EV demand softness offsets strategic supply chain security premiums.

Manganese.note: Correlated to weak Chinese steel production and iron ore demand dynamics.

PGM.note: Weak auto sales offset by supply constraints and emerging hydrogen economy potential.

Potash.note: Tight global supply and steady agricultural demand support pricing power.

Aluminum.note: Green energy demand and Chinese smelter capacity caps support a structural deficit.

Diversified.note: Broad commodity basket provides balanced exposure to base metal growth and iron ore.
